feedback.end: Parrots are colourful birds that live in rainforests. This one has red, blue and yellow feathers and a powerful beak, which can open hard nuts and seeds.
This beautiful butterfly’s natural habitat is the rainforest. The butterfly uses its blue wings to fly around and also to scare away predators.
These frogs also live in the rainforest. They can be lots of different colours: red, blue, green and even yellow. The bright colours warn other animals that they are poisonous.

atoms.a: Rainforests are full of colourful animals.
Rainforests are very green and rainy.
Rainforests are a natural habitat for many different plants.
